centroid_hz.label: centre of the shaking's spectrum, 1-45 Hz

flatness.label: how noise-like the spectrum is (1 = flat noise)

kurt.label: how impulsive the shaking is (excess kurtosis; 0 = steady)

windows.rule: around every timeline event's onset (events/eruptions.json): hours_before .. hours_after (or whole UTC days: days_before .. days_after), plus extra_spans; merged
windows.absent_means: outside the windows a window tier is absent by design: read the finest full-record tier (or the O1 source); it is not silence

raw.note: a continuous station's wave hours inside its windows; no spectrogram files when spec_files is false (the page computes them from the wave). MELH keeps its whole day

windows.o1: everything else (f1m and f10s for the whole record, every channel, spectrogram files) comes through the O1 source: a folder or a server holding the same tree
windows.note: desktop and web read this same tree

engine_applies.comb_fold: comb_hz by whole octaves into [33.0, 150.0] Hz (= comb_render_hz)
engine_applies.note: the pin and rest gains are priced on exactly this render

constants.ring: 0.8 + 6 * amp (amp: room max = 1), no overtone damping
constants.seesaw: 1 + s (1 - 2 l) cos(pi theta), s = 0.5 + 0.5 l, l = log-frequency position in the room
constants.pin: sqrt(P(room, gains 1) / P(point)) at the point's pressure; P = sum S_bow |H|^2 (re_wilding rw_power), pink-extended above 3 kHz; capped at +30 dB (v0.11.3)
constants.regime_peaks: log spectrum (v0.11.3): the 12 strongest dB maxima per component, >= 1/12 octave apart; amp = dB above the room's 5th-percentile floor
constants.mode_order: deformation: SKSH n,e,u, SENG n,e,u, THOB n,e,u x 4; regime: Z, N, E x 12

provenance.Provider: Leif Karlstrom (Dept. Earth Sciences, U Oregon; Volcano Listening Project), compiled from IMO (Veðurstofa Íslands) data
provenance.Channel: Dropbox shared folder (link in Leif's email of 2026-09-25), updated by Leif 2026-10-19
provenance.Unpacked to: raw/leif_dropbox_2026-10-19/` (Leif's folder layout kept as-is; `.ipynb_checkpoints/` dropped)
provenance.not_for_publication: IMO lava-flow / effusion data (none of it is in viz/data)
provenance.catalogue: IMO earthquake catalogue (Svartsengi polygon), located + magnitude-estimated by IMO
provenance.gnss: daily N/E/U, IMO stations SKSH, SENG, THOB (files *_060423_092426_I.csv)
provenance.waveforms: RK.MELH.10 HH* 100 Hz + LM* 1 Hz miniSEED, 2024-01-14 00:00-10:23 UTC, raw counts

flags: MELH's position is a placeholder (pos_status approx, 2 km): no public service lists RK.MELH; SKSH, SENG, THOB from IMO's GNSS browser / site logs (measured)
waveforms are raw counts (no instrument response yet)
MELH covers 2024-01-14 00:00-10:23 UTC only; the station was overrun by lava
GNSS straight-line (interpolated) days are flagged <ST>_interp; all three stations are interpolated across the 14 Jan 2024 eruption
GNSS 1-2 day excursions that return are flagged <ST>_spike
the rooms and waits are bounded by IMO's eruption timeline (events/eruptions.json); deflation_events is W1's GNSS detection, kept for the comparison (gnss_match)
fc_hz assumes a 3 MPa stress drop and treats ML as Mw
eq_b uses one whole-catalogue Mc (max curvature)
